models.assessment: Default reasoning completed in 65–109 seconds; explicit none shortened the observed runs to 9–28 seconds, with domain modelling errors still present. Cloud serving timings do not predict local RAM or speed.

models.rationale: European provider alternative with multimodal and long-context support.
models.assessment: Catalog advertises none but actual provider rejects it. Explicit low, medium and high tests are recorded separately. More reasoning did not monotonically increase latency or guarantee completeness. The selected EU provider tag does not qualify EU-only gateway processing.
models.configuration_correction: Correction dated 11 November 2026: expanded-campaign measurements used provider default after a separate none request was rejected. Earlier metadata labelled the measured row none. Low/medium/high ablations are separate.

models.rationale: Low-priced compact MoE from a document-processing vendor.
models.assessment: Three passages completed; zero candidates passed the current deterministic checks. Wrong claim-kind fields, absent graph nodes and misassigned evidence anchors. This is a failure with the current prompt/contract, not evidence that all Solar document products fail.

models.rationale: Enterprise-oriented model with structured output and optional reasoning.
models.assessment: HTTP400 caused by unsupported maxItems/minItems constraints, confirmed against Cohere documentation. Removing those only from the provider schema permits replies; original limits remain checked locally. Adapted replay still truncates one passage and changes possible impacts into definite ones.

models.rationale: Learned multi-agent orchestrator, not an independent single foundation model.
models.assessment: HTTP404 Filter by Parameters. Endpoint advertises structured_outputs but omits max_tokens and response_format used by PALO. Not admitted to this bounded adapter; do not silently drop spending controls or infer poor reasoning quality.
